status_meaning: tested on one sanitized live 1.0.100 run (copilot-otel-1); every route is experimental (no field-disposition catalog or oracle profile yet)

sources.establishes: the persisted session: session start and version, the prompt, the system message, assistant messages with their tool requests, tool execution start and completion, per-call usage records with model cost multipliers and nano-AIU, usage checkpoints and the shutdown's accounting

the same persisted events plus ephemeral progress (message and tool-call deltas, shell output, partial results, model-call progress), richer tool results (detailed content, MCP content lists) and the CLI's result with its exit code and session

sources.content_settings: file exporter with content capture on: message, system, tool definition and tool argument/result attributes present; without it they are absent, never empty
sources.establishes: per-call chat spans (usage, multiplier, nano-AIU, finish reasons, service request ids), per-execution tool spans (arguments, result text, status), the invocation's totals including its multiplier sum, tool definitions and MCP servers, and run metrics
the session's final accounting at exit: premium requests, nano-AIU, token details overall and per model and agent

joins.basis: a persisted event keeps its own id on standard output and in the session file
one model call: an assistant message's and a usage record's data.apiCallId, a checkpoint's last model_call_id and a chat span's gen_ai.response.id name the same provider call

tool.execution_complete data.toolCallId and an execute_tool span's gen_ai.tool.call.id name the same model-facing call; partial result events remain separate observations by their distinct native event ids

the execution's final accounting, one per execution: the session file's shutdown snapshot, the usage report the launch named and the OTel invocation span; a second occurrence of one of these rules in one source makes the entity ambiguous

authorities.basis: the event routes' data.result object (text content, detailed content, MCP contents, structuredContent) is the CLI's result; an OTel span's gen_ai.tool.call.result is its text rendering, kept on the span's observation

limits: standard output reports per-call usage only for the last call (checkpoint); the other calls' usage is the session file's and OTel's
a usage report names no session: it belongs to the launch that named the file
the OTel invocation's github.copilot.cost is a multiplier sum, never premium requests; premium requests come from the session file, standard output and the usage report
